hookLine: Let's rank the most epic volleyball moments ever! From painful mistakes to pure gravity-defying talent.

items.voiceLine: Spiking the ball with full force directly into your own teammate's head instead of over the net. Tragic, painful, and somehow always caught on camera. D-Tier, an all-time cringe moment.
The setter completely whiffing an easy set, letting the ball just bounce on the floor while everyone stands there confused. C-Tier, a classic team-chemistry breakdown.
Earvin N'Gapeth's no-look fake spike fools the entire opposing block without even looking at the ball. Disrespectful, genius, pure showmanship. A-Tier, he's just toying with them.
But Yuji Nishida jumping so high he looks like he's leaving the entire gym for a monster kill? S-Tier gravity defiance, the man plays a different sport.

outroLine: Do you play volleyball? Comment below!
